Required Equipment

  • 6 Boxes or Parcels or Levitate spell.
  • Possibly Shovel and Rope or Magic Rope.
  • The New Frontier Quest mission 8.
  • A melee weapon to break some Wooden Bars for mission 2.

To start this quest, find NPC Zalamon in the very east of Zao, one floor down.









































Browse Map (33340, 31415, 7)

Missions

Prove Your Worzz!

You need to go through the teleport here (33198, 31350, 7) to the area north of the Dragonblaze Peaks and go to the far east. There is a little camp of lizards and the Tactical Map is on the shelves inside the first building you see. Be ready to face Lizard Zaoguns along with other High Class Lizards. The camp is located here (33280, 31221, 7).

You have to deliver the map in LESS THAN 1 HOUR to complete the mission, otherwise you'll have to start it again.

After you have the map, go back to Zalamon and say 'mission'.

Mission 1: Corruption

Go to the Temple of Equilibrium (it's marked on your map - here (33177, 31194, 7)) and follow the stairs up to the top and back down to the bottom on the other side, you'll face many Lizard Zaoguns along with other lizards you have battled already. There are hidden stairs behind the double set of stairs which you came down (here (33178, 31192, 6)), when you go down there are 5 Lizard Chosen. Red text comes up saying you passed.
Note: You can jump back up immediately to avoid being hit.

Hint: if you don't want to waste a lot of supplies killing the Lizard Zaogun fighting your way up, it is possible to go up the first floor and use Levitate to get to the other side, on the red circle in the image:

You'll find 2 Lizard Zaogun and 1 Lizard Dragon Priest going down, but you can run to the stairs and go immediately up afterwards.

You can exit the temple of equilibrium here (33186, 31205, 6), by using Vines
Report back to Zalamon.

Mission 2: Imperial Zzecret Weaponzz

Go into the small camp Chaochai to the north of the Dragonblaze Peaks (Zalamon marks the entrance on your map, the camp is here (33238, 31166, 7)). There are 3 buildings which you have to enter (marked with stars on the map):

  • a food storage room on ground floor, here (33230, 31154, 7)
  • weapon storage room in a basement (which you need a melee weapon to break through Wooden Bars), here (33228, 31149, 8)
  • a barracks on ground floor, here (33258, 31170, 7)

You'll get a red message on your screen for each one. Don't forget to grab the Tome of Knowledge located in the north-eastern-most building, one flight up. You will find a chest that contains the Tome.

Once you have found them return to Zalamon.

Mission 3: Zee Killing Fieldzz

First, get the Flask of Poison from Zalamon's storage room west of the stairs.

Then, go to the teleporter to the Muggy Plains and head east from there to the rice fields (here (33281, 31142, 7)). Go to the very top rice field and use the poison anywhere on the water. After you use the poison, go to the north-east and find the building for the next part, Mission 4. You can enter the building and receive the red message when you reach the basement (pictured below) to report back to Zalamon, saving a trip and resources. Then head back to NPC Zalamon to finish the mission.

Mission 4: Zze Way of Zztonezz

Note: You can do this part during the previous mission and also talk to Zalamon about symbols while giving report of mission 3.

Head east from the teleport in Muggy Plains, past the rice fields located in the north-east. There will be a lot of High Class Lizards along the way and some Mutated Tigers, Mutated Bats and Death Blobs when you get close to the right place. Go up the stairs (here (33311, 31135, 7)) and follow the mountain pass (where there's 1 Mutated Tiger). Keep going up and into a building, go inside and make your way as far down the stairs as possible to a room with some strange symbols. A red message will appear.

Head back to NPC Zalamon and say to him strange symbols. He will tell you to take a Flask of Extra Greasy Oil from a Small Bamboo Shelf in his storage room. Go back to the building in Muggy Plains to the room with the levers and use the grease on them. Then use the levers to arrange the symbols in the center of the room to match the symbols on the bottom floor. You will get a red message when you have done it right. Report back to Zalamon.

You will receive a Tome of Knowledge as a reward for completing this mission.

Mission 5: Phantom Army

Note¹: Players who have previously completed this part can ask NPC "Zalamon" for "Task" and choose "Zztrike", which allows the person to enter again but their mission is to kill the Lizard Gate Guardian.
Note²: If you are receiving help from a player that has already completed the Wrath of the Emperor Quest, that player must get the Zztrike task from Chartan, as he can no longer access Zalamon.

To do this mission you must have 4 players in your group. In the building where you were on the previous mission you can now go down to access a room with a blue flame teleport. Walk into the teleport. In the area past the teleport the players must each stand in a square that is missing a lizard statue for 10–30 seconds. You will all see a message that you hear "distant clicks" when standing on your square.

After this all players need to walk south where you will find some stairs leading up. There's a time limit and if you take too long to go up the stairs you won't be able to continue. When you go up you are in the area where the Phantom Army will spawn, which consists of Eternal Guardians and Lizards Chosen. It is suggested to hide away in the south-western or north-eastern part of the area and block the way with Fire Bomb Runes to avoid fighting the army entirely. After surviving for 10 minutes you will be teleported out by Zalamon and you can report the mission to him.

The most eastern house has a spot (33277, 31111, 7) where you are able to use levitate (Exani Hur Up) and stay completely out of the way of spawned creatures.

NB: There is a Tome of Knowledge in a chest in the building on the east side of the path (here (33264, 31130, 7)) leading to the gate (south from where you begin).

Tasks

After completing the main quest, Zalamon can still offer you one daily task and one weekly task. Chartan also offers you a daily task after completing the Wrath of the Emperor Quest. Note that being able to take Chartan's task means that Zalamon is no longer accessible to you and that you will have to take his tasks from Chartan too.

Daily Task: Zzuppliezz

First say to Zalamon "supplies", and accept the mission. You need to go in the Lizard Town that the Zalamon have marked in your map at mission 2: Imperial Zzecret Weaponzz, there you need to go one floor down and use the lizard's weapon rack and get a Weapons Crate.

After the Weapons Crate, you need to find some Fishes hanging on a wall and you will receive two Corned Fish.

At the east side of the village say hi to the Lizard Prisoners and then use only one Corned Fish at the wall where they are trapped.

When you do it you'll get the "Vive la Resistance" achievement.

Report back to Zalamon about your mission; you need to have the Weapons Crate and the other Corned Fish with you and then he will reward you with one of the following: Red Gem, Green Gem, Blue Gem, or Zaoan Armor.

Daily Task: Collect

Note: Only after completing the Wrath of the Emperor Quest does Chartan have any tasks to offer you.

Talk to Chartan and check the "tasks" he has to offer, then ask about the "collect" one and accept it. You need to collect seven items, that can be obtained by using several plants around northern Zao, all of them can be find on this area (33192, 31081, 7) (going above from where Chartan is).

List of the items:

  • Screaming Cherry
  • Toxic Tulip Seed
  • Witherblossom
  • Meaty Vortex
  • Tonguefruit
  • Sprocketwhip Cone
  • Rotten Witches Cauldron Seed



































Browse Map (33192, 31100, 7)

List of the plants that give them: (there are few plants of each type, but here you can see the exact location of at least one of each kind, also the plants can be collected in any order)

  • Screaming Cherry Tree *here (33194, 31086, 7)


  • Tonguefruit *here (33203, 31080, 7)


  • Sprocketwhip Cone *here (33231, 31076, 7)


  • Toxic Tulip Seed *here (33196, 31100, 7)


  • Witherblossom *here (33207, 31100, 7)


  • Rotten Witches Cauldron Seed *here (33193, 31113, 7)


  • Meaty Vortex *here (33178, 31112, 7)


Say "hi" to Chartan and eat all the weird food you got, after eating them say "collect" to him.

When you do it you'll get the "Extreme Degustation" achievement.

As reward for this task you can get one of these group of items (depending on your vocation):

Knights may get:

  • 12000 experience points, 100 Mana Potions and Terra Amulet or;
  • 12000 experience points, 25 Great Health Potion and Dwarven Ring or;
  • 20000 experience points or;
  • 25000 experience points

Paladins may get:

  • 12000 experience points, 50 Assassin Stars and Terra Amulet or;
  • 12000 experience points, 25 Great Spirit Potion and Dwarven ring or;
  • 20000 experience points or;
  • 25000 experience points

Druids and Sorcerers may get:

  • 12000 experience points, 45 Sudden Death runes and Terra Amulet or;
  • 12000 experience points, 40 Great Mana Potion and Dwarven ring or;
  • 20000 experience points or;
  • 25000 experience points

Weekly Task: Zze Art of War

Ask Zalamon for the strike mission, or if you have lost access to Zalamon through the Wrath of the Emperor Quest, ask Chartan at the Rebel Camp.

This task is the same as Mission 5: Phantom Army. With the weekly task you can help other players with mission 5, collect the Tome of Knowledge there and/or kill the Lizard Gate Guardian boss.

This task can be repeated after 6 days and 20 hours.

The reward of this task is 10000 experience.
